description: The exact price of a one-off order of opted-in UK consumer data for a volume (1,000 to 1,000,000 records) and a targeting choice, the same price the DataMembership website charges. Use list_targeting_filters first for the filter keys and option values. Nothing is ordered or charged: the customer places the order on datamembership.com. Does not show how many records match.
